notes: §14.1.3: "There are no exceptions, no `try`/`catch`/`throw`, and no way to catch a panic inside Kalam code (04 L6)." §21.3 K0908: "`try:`, `catch`, `throw`, `raise` | `?` on a `Result`, or `return Err(…)`". `try` is not a keyword (§7.1) and stays ASCII in every skin. Stage `parse`: §21.3 mistakes "are detected only in the obvious syntactic position".
